description: Na₂LiAlP₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmce space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.96-3.10 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five P atoms. There are a spread of Na-P bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.09 Å. Li is bonded to four P atoms to form distorted LiP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiP₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent AlP₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one LiP₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent AlP₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.52 Å) and two longer (2.58 Å) Li-P bond lengths. Al is bonded to four P atoms to form distorted AlP₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent LiP₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent AlP₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one AlP₄ tetrahedra, and edges with three equivalent LiP₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.41 Å) and two longer (2.44 Å) Al-P bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to five Na, two equivalent Li, and two equivalent Al atoms. In the second P site, P is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to five Na, two equivalent Li, and two equivalent Al atoms.
